note: v2495: v2493s commit said A1 was proven not a naming problem because the resolver joined zero organ-id to lane-name pairs. A cold review refused that inference - zero only tells you the resolver found no matches, not that the keys are different kinds of thing - and named the test that settles it. One command found shadowWatch equals tvd-shadow-watch. The zero measured my own reach, not the world. same_thing now strips the tvd prefix and camelCase and joins that one pair while over-reaching on none. A1 is PARTLY a naming problem; the lane scorer is still its substance.
